criteria.P0_replay: smoke stage: the 10 sources replayed through the pilot runner reach stable success in >= 8/10, and condition A reaches stable success in >= 3/4 smoke poses; otherwise the runner/env is broken -> stop, report
criteria.S1_executable: condition C: stable handover success >= 15/24 (62.5 %) AND not more than 3 below condition A
criteria.S2_novel: among C's stable successes, >= 50 % are NOVEL: executed handover descriptor outside the source envelope (pass point >= 3 cm from every source pass point, OR receiver grasp height/azimuth in the can frame outside the source range by >= 1 cm / 10 deg), AND C's median novelty ratio >= 0.5 while A's is <= 0.2
criteria.S3_quality: C stable successes: post-transfer retention >= 30 steps in >= 90 %; slip > 1.5 cm rate not more than 15 points above the P0 source-replay rate in the same env (known-good GT demos already show 27.5 %, 11/40); 0 joint-target safety-contract violations; 0 arm-arm clearance violations (offline capsule check on the measured joints)
criteria.S4_constraints_matter: reported, not a GO condition: C - B stable success (paired by pose, McNemar)

stop_rule: One pilot run per condition on the frozen 24 poses. If S1, S2 or S3 fails for C: NO-GO for scaling this generator; do not retune ranges on the same poses. If all hold: GO for a scaled generation experiment (new poses, a policy-level test) - still NOT evidence of policy benefit or force awareness.
